feedback.markdownBody:
VERIFICATION FAILED for PAN-4597 (attempt 1/3):

Failed check: vbrief-ac

Acceptance criteria check FAILED — 8/8 AC incomplete:

### Expose the gate answer's refresh age in approval-at-head (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given a gate answer recorded at the head, when less than GATE_ANSWER_REFRESH_AFTER_MS has passed, then approvalAtHeadNeedsRefresh returns false
  - [ ] Given a gate answer older than GATE_ANSWER_REFRESH_AFTER_MS or for another head, when asked, then approvalAtHeadNeedsRefresh returns true

### List a project's open PRs and MRs by issue (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given a GitHub project, when listOpenPullRequestsForProject runs, then it returns open non-draft PRs keyed by the issue in their feature branch
  - [ ] Given a GitLab project, when listOpenPullRequestsForProject runs, then it reads the merge request listing instead of gh

### Refresh gate answers for approved green PRs on the UAT-train tick (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given an approved green mergeable PR and ticks every minute, when 12 minutes pass, then the issue still derives ready
  - [ ] Given two ticks inside the refresh window for the same head, when the tick runs, then the gate is asked once

### Document what makes a PR ready (2/2 incomplete)
  - [ ] Given docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md, when read, then it lists the conditions for derived ready
  - [ ] Given docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md, when read, then it describes the approval refresher and its refresh window

## REQUIRED: Complete all acceptance criteria BEFORE resubmitting

1. Review the incomplete AC above
2. Implement the missing requirements and write tests
3. Close every completed task with `pan task close` — the canonical writer publishes the close and AC statuses sync automatically; never hand-edit spec files
4. Commit and push ALL changes
5. ONLY THEN resubmit: pan review request PAN-4597 -m "Completed acceptance criteria"

Do NOT resubmit until all AC are completed.
